data.heading: Two partners who do the work. No layer in between.
data.lede: There's no sales team, and no hand-off to a junior account manager after you sign. There are two of us, we own the business equally, and we're the two who build and run the thing. Either of us answers the phone.

data.heading: Four things we'll say on the first call, whether or not you hire us.

items.title: Measure before you spend more
items.body: Most accounts don't need more budget. They need to know which dollars are producing customers. Fix the counting first, then scale what works.

items.title: You own your accounts, your site and your history
items.body: Ad accounts, domain, content and phone numbers stay in your name. If you ever leave, nothing switches off and nothing is held hostage.

items.title: Technology is an extension of us, not a replacement
items.body: We built software, and some of it uses AI, because it lets two people watch every account every day. Every change it proposes is read and signed by one of us. It never spends on its own.

items.title: Say no to the plausible bad idea
items.body: Taking accountability for the outcome means having opinions about the plan. We'll tell you when ads aren't the right first move, or when a redesign won't fix what's wrong.
